mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_trial_balance_line (id, run_id, chart_account_id, opening_balance, period_debit, period_credit, closing_balance, create_time) VALUES (#{row.id}, #{row.runId}, #{row.chartAccountId}, #{row.openingBalance}, #{row.periodDebit}, #{row.periodCredit}, #{row.closingBalance}, #{row.createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT l.chart_account_id, c.account_no, c.account_code, c.account_name, c.account_class, c.normal_side, c.parent_account_id parent_chart_account_id, c.posting_allowed, l.opening_balance, l.period_debit, l.period_credit, l.closing_balance FROM t_trial_balance_line l JOIN t_chart_account c ON c.id = l.chart_account_id WHERE l.run_id = #{runId} ORDER BY c.account_no
